children: CoreWeave (CRWV) shares rose about 1% in morning trading Wednesday as the AI cloud provider added new NVIDIA computing technology to its platform and expanded its network of validated software partners.

The company is bringing NVIDIA (NVDA) Vera CPUs to its cloud portfolio for workloads tied to AI agents. It will also offer NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72 systems for production use, with Cognition serving as the first customer running workloads on the platform.

CoreWeave said the Rubin systems are already operating on its cloud service, marking a move from infrastructure deployment toward commercial use. The company said customers can access the hardware under its existing operating model for NVIDIA systems.

Separately, CoreWeave launched a partner network covering technology integrations tested in production environments. The offering includes collaborations with CrowdStrike, VAST Data, Reflection and ClickHouse.

The company introduced the developments at its Fully Connected AI conference in San Francisco. The partner network is available now, while Vera CPU availability is being expanded as CoreWeave prepares for additional AI agent workloads.

title: CoreWeave Stock Climbs on NVIDIA Vera Rubin Expansion
